purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt software system. It creates and edits monthly billing detail files for medical insurance receipts (レセプト), specifically handling comment editing for receipt types including injury compensation and self-pay claims. It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM files (RECE41, RECE44, RECE45 and work variants) and produces an error file.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance)

verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but the comments are Japanese (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), causing mojibake in the displayed text. The source is clearly genuine production COBOL from the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) that are not included in this excerpt, so full data division structure cannot be verified from this snippet alone. The // pseudo-text delimiter style in REPLACING clauses is characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL rather than IBM Enterprise COBOL.
